card.name: Split or garbled drug label terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a short word piece inside a garbled or split term, such as the Ci in rad/mCi, the oad in Coadministration, or the last letter of a brand name like JESDUVROQ. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: Unit ending Ci
modes.description: The Ci piece of the radiation dose unit rad/mCi in dosimetry tables.
modes.example: y/ MBq rad/mCi μGy/ MBq rad/m<<Ci>> μGy/ MBq rad/m

modes.label: Split Coadministration
modes.description: The oad piece in the split word Coadministration at the start of an interaction statement.
modes.example: P) 1B1/3. C<<oad>>ministration with MAVYRET may increase

modes.label: End of brand name
modes.description: The final letter or piece of a brand or product name, such as Q in JESDUVROQ.
modes.example: Correct and exclude other causes of anemia (e.g., vitamin deficiency, metabolic or chronic inflammatory conditions, bleeding) before initiating JESDUVRO<<Q>>. Evaluate the iron status in all patients
